tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Codenation index of developer and SaaS tools. Every word of `query` must match the tool's name, tags, tagline, category or description; results are ranked by relevance. Filter by `category`, `tag` or `pricing`. Returns short records (slug, name, tagline, category, pricing, tags, website,

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full Codenation record of one tool by its slug (as returned by search_tools): description, makers, category, tags, pricing model, website, the collections it belongs to, and when available a checked presentation with what it does, who it suits, the price read on the tool's own pricing page,

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List every Codenation collection: hand-picked groups of tools that do the same job (for example authentication for SaaS, or privacy-friendly analytics). Returns slug, name, title, description, number of tools, tool slugs and codenation_url. Call get_collection for the tools and their prices.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get one Codenation collection by slug (as returned by list_collections): its introduction and each tool with a short price and the date that price was checked. Returns an error result if the slug is unknown.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories of the Codenation index with their slug, name, description and number of tools. Use a slug as the category filter of search_tools.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: Submit a project to the Codenation review queue as a free listing. Nothing is published by this call: a person reviews every submission and may decline it. A free listing links to the project with rel="nofollow". Requires the project's name, its full https:// URL and a contact email for the reviewer

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tool · Private data: search_tools, get_tool, submit_tool · Public sink: submit_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tool · Private data: search_tools, get_tool, submit_tool · Public sink: submit_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
